title: Draped, Not Dressed

image.alt: Model in a flowing ivory satin dress caught in movement

excerpt: The evening edit is built around cloth that moves after you stop. Notes from the studio on drape, weight and light.

body.text: Drape is what happens when cloth is allowed to decide. It follows the body, catches the light and settles a moment after you do.
Satin and viscose behave very differently on the same pattern. We test each drape on a moving model, then adjust the cut until the fabric looks unhurried.
If it looks arranged, it is not draped. It should look as though it fell into place.
Evening pieces ask for little else: minimal jewellery, a quiet shoe and enough room to move.
